company.name: Scale
company.shortDescription: Scale AI provides a data-oriented platform that assists in the development of AI applications.
company.description: Scale AI develops a data-oriented platform that provides training and validation data for artificial intelligence applications. The company's LiDAR, video, and image annotation APIs allow self-driving, drone, and robotics teams at companies like Lyft, OpenAI, Zoox, Pinterest, and Airbnb to focus on building differentiated models vs. labeling data.

productsAndServices.description: A data platform for collecting, curating, annotating, and evaluating datasets used to train and improve machine learning and generative AI models.

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise platform for customizing, evaluating, and deploying generative AI applications using enterprise data, foundation models, human feedback, and agent infrastructure.

productsAndServices.description: Services for adapting foundation models to specific domains and behaviors through supervised fine-tuning, human feedback, preference ranking, and reinforcement learning workflows.
productsAndServices.name: RLHF and Model Customization Services

productsAndServices.description: Evaluation and assurance services for measuring model performance, identifying weaknesses, and assessing safety, reliability, alignment, and readiness for deployment.
